title: See a model another process downloads while the first goal waits
goal: On a fresh install the daemon can finish the starter download while the shell's first goal waits; the shell's 60-second model scan cache hid it until after the 120-second wait expired. The cache is now also keyed on the shared models folder's modification time.
scopes: version surfaces prepared by local release prepare-next patch
acceptance: A model file added to the models folder without an in-process generation bump is listed by the next scan
The regression test fails on the previous cache key
Native combined-tree acceptance and qualified fresh 8 GiB Windows VM journey remain required before production promotion
